mechanism_name: Proof of Stake with Tower BFT and Proof of History clocking

evidence.label: Solana consensus overview
evidence.claim: Solana documents proof of stake with Tower BFT, while Proof of History provides a global clock before consensus.

evidence.label: Solana Tower BFT
evidence.claim: Tower BFT is a PoH-optimized PBFT-derived consensus mechanism; Proof of History is a clock before consensus rather than a complete standalone consensus mechanism.

evidence.label: Solana quantum readiness
evidence.claim: Solana has published quantum-readiness migration work; this profile does not treat consensus PQ migration as deployed.
